evidence_label_definitions.FACT: directly supported by a cited or mechanically verified artifact
evidence_label_definitions.INFERENCE: derived from facts with the reasoning recorded

sources.label: FACT
sources.claim: Frozen scientific question, design-only scope, zero-endpoint window, and exact old-result preservation string.

sources.label: FACT
sources.claim: Frozen observation fields and exact V and D definitions; V uses any of five fields and D uses step_result_consistency or answer_consistency.

sources.label: FACT
sources.claim: Paired res and terminal-answer differences set the two D-consumed observation fields without changing the detection rule.

sources.label: FACT
sources.claim: 7134 records, 10960 steps, 2894 multi-step records, fixed step keys, and terminal answer types float=7000, yes=80, no=54.

sources.label: FACT
sources.claim: Candidate reconstructed grammar, arithmetic rules, percent handling, dependency resolution, comparison tolerance, and fail-closed unevaluable behavior.

sources.label: FACT
sources.claim: The two percent readings were fixed in advance and the line was stopped if both pct fidelity values remained below 0.5.

sources.label: FACT
sources.claim: Pct fidelity was 44/1478 and 330/1478, both below 0.5; the stop condition fired; numeric mismatch remained 518/3096 and official semantics were not established.

sources.label: FACT
sources.claim: Existing overlap feasibility counts are E=7134, P=6794, N=6929 and are not causal-exposure eligibility or V/D/O outcomes.

sources.label: FACT

assumptions.label: FACT
assumptions.claim: The old result must remain exactly FAILED TRANSFER DUE TO MEASUREMENT-OBJECT MISMATCH and must not be merged with the new proposal.

assumptions.label: INFERENCE
assumptions.claim: Under a fixed gold-program and gold-argument path, E mutation can affect visibility fields but cannot affect res, answer, or D input.
assumptions.condition: no separate deterministic evidence-to-argument extraction stage exists

assumptions.label: INFERENCE
assumptions.claim: P and N can be causally exposed to D only if an admitted deterministic executor recomputes target res, dependent descendants, and terminal answer.
assumptions.condition: executor contract and exact clean replay pass

assumptions.label: DESIGN_REQUIREMENT
assumptions.claim: Only the executor may write substantive res and terminal answer fields; the mutation stage writes only legal P or N target fields.

assumptions.label: DESIGN_REQUIREMENT
assumptions.claim: Eligibility uses structural inputs and replay status only, never V, D, O, correctness, or expected effect.

uncertainties.label: UNVERIFIED
uncertainties.claim: Official FinQA arithmetic, percent, rounding, variant, precision, and serialization semantics are not established from the approved staged artifacts.
uncertainties.impact: P/N execution must remain conditional and stopped.
uncertainties.resolution: hash-bound official or independently reviewed executor contract

uncertainties.label: CONTESTED
uncertainties.claim: The structure document reports 21 op roots, while the static parser over the same source counts 22 family-plus-variant roots before position suffix removal.
uncertainties.impact: operator coverage and exclusion inventory cannot be finalized
uncertainties.resolution: freeze the raw-token and root-count definition in the executor contract

uncertainties.label: UNVERIFIED
uncertainties.claim: Terminal answer derivation for percent, boolean, and seven other result forms is not specified by an admitted executor.
uncertainties.impact: answer_consistency and D cannot be causally generated without missing semantics

uncertainties.label: UNVERIFIED
uncertainties.claim: Legal P replacement sets and N mutation rules are not frozen.
uncertainties.impact: mutation admission and outcome-blind selection are undefined
uncertainties.resolution: freeze mutation grammar before any eligibility or outcome access

uncertainties.label: UNVERIFIED
uncertainties.claim: All-record exact clean replay has not been run under this proposal.
uncertainties.impact: eligible count and eligible rate remain NOT_ESTIMABLE_PRE_EXECUTION
uncertainties.resolution: authorized later implementation run with exact two-run evidence

uncertainties.label: UNVERIFIED
uncertainties.claim: Report-cluster uniqueness and split safety for the later causal-exposure population are not frozen here.
uncertainties.resolution: freeze outcome-blind cluster and split manifests before execution

completion_boundary: analysis of sources complete; assumptions explicit; execution not authorized; no result accepted
